> [!CAUTION]
> This issue template is strictly for reports where files or data were removed unintentionally. It is treated with the highest priority by maintainers.

## What Happened?
Describe exactly what action was taken in DustMap and what was removed.

## Targets Affected
- Path(s) that were removed:
- Was the action intended to move to Trash or Delete Forever?
- Can the files be located in macOS Trash?

## Audit Log
Please attach the relevant section of your local audit log (found under `~/Library/Application Support/DustMap/audit.jsonl`).

## System Information
- macOS Version:
- DustMap Version:
- Rule ID (if known):
